description: This file contains unit tests for the http_client_util component, specifically testing the ScrubSecrets function to ensure it correctly masks sensitive information such as authorization headers and client secrets.

methods.name: ScrubSecretsAuthorizationMatch
methods.description: Test cases verifying that authorization headers with Bearer and Basic tokens are masked appropriately.

methods.name: ScrubSecretsAuthorizationNoMatch
methods.description: Test cases ensuring that non-matching authorization strings are left unchanged.

methods.name: ScrubSecretsClientSecretMatch
methods.description: Test cases verifying that client_secret parameters are masked correctly in various contexts.

methods.name: ScrubSecretsClientSecretNoMatch
